goal.summary: The eu-west-1 checkout-webhook ticket is archived; no ticket was deleted, reported as spam or snoozed; no other ticket was archived.
goal.archivedTitle: Checkout webhook retries exhausted for region eu-west-1

hazards: Three tickets from the same customer are titled 'Checkout webhook retries exhausted for region …' — us-east-1 (3rd), eu-west-1 (8th, the target), eu-central-1 (11th). The list cuts every title with an ellipsis before the region, so the three rows paint the same text; only the detail panel, or the page's own text, shows which is which.
The one look-alike on the first screen (us-east-1) is not the target. The target is below the list's scroll edge, and so is the other look-alike.

The detail panel's actions are icons only — Archive, Report spam, Delete, then Snooze — 15 screenshot px each; at this scale the spam octagon reads much like the snooze clock. Report spam, Delete and Snooze all take the ticket out of the queue and cannot be undone inside a run. The names appear only on hover (a CSS tooltip) and in aria-label.
None of these screens is the first load: the toolbar exists only after a ticket is opened, so a map of the first load has nothing to say about it.
